name: @automatos/theme-harness
description: Runs a theme without an Automatos host: its tests in vitest (jsdom, React, Testing Library and the jest-dom matchers, @automatos/theme-sdk resolved to a fake SDK held to the vendored types, and the fake host's controls), and the theme itself in a browser, in a mock host app with a toolbar, shot on Chromium and WebKit with an axe scan.
